q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Forecasting NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance (Revenue)

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is August 15, 2026. NVIDIA is expected to release Q2 FY2027 earnings around August 26, 2026 (per the research provided). This means resolution is approximately **11 days away**.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided official forward guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** (range: $89.18B - $92.82B).

The question asks what NVIDIA's forward guidance will be in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release, which is the formal guidance they announce when they report those results. Since the guidance has already been issued (as of May 20, 2026), the earnings release on ~August 26 will simply reaffirm or slightly adjust this guidance.

Key considerations:
- The official guidance is already public: $91.0B ±2%
- This guidance explicitly excludes China Data Center compute revenue
- Analyst consensus sits at $91.8B, with a range of $90.3B-$96.7B
- The question resolution range is 99.5B-115.5B with open bounds

The most likely scenario is that NVIDIA will either:
1. Reaffirm the $91.0B guidance (most likely)
2. Make a modest adjustment based on business developments between May and August

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Macro deterioration**: Sudden slowdown in AI capex from hyperscalers
- **Supply chain issues**: Manufacturing or logistics disruptions affecting Q2 shipments
- **Geopolitical complications**: Additional China restrictions impacting demand
- **Customer inventory corrections**: Hyperscalers pausing orders due to oversupply
- **Conservative revision**: Management becoming cautious due to unforeseen headwinds

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Stronger than expected demand**: Hyperscalers accelerating AI investments beyond expectations
- **Margin expansion**: Higher-margin product mix driving revenue upside
- **New customer wins**: Enterprise or cloud adoption accelerating faster than modeled
- **Supply chain improvements**: Ability to ship more units than originally planned
- **Geopolitical upside**: Potential relaxation of China restrictions creating new revenue

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

**From the research provided:**
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion (85% YoY growth)
- Q2 FY2027 official guidance: $91.0 billion ±2% ($89.18B-$92.82B)
- Analyst consensus: $91.8 billion (range: $90.3B-$96.7B)

This represents 11.8% sequential growth from Q1 to the midpoint of Q2 guidance, which is consistent with NVIDIA's seasonal patterns and strong demand environment.

---

## Analysis

Given that:
1. Official guidance of $91.0B ±2% has already been issued
2. There is only 11 days until the earnings release
3. No major negative developments have been reported since May
4. The analyst consensus of $91.8B sits near the midpoint of guidance

The probability distribution should be heavily concentrated around $91.0B with a slight upward bias reflecting:
- Analyst consensus trending slightly above midpoint
- Historical tendency for companies to guide conservatively
- Strong momentum in AI chip demand continuing
- The ±2% band already provides management flexibility

The range provided (99.5B-115.5B) is quite wide relative to the guidance band. The question appears designed to accommodate actual results and forward guidance revisions, but we expect minimal change from the already-issued $91.0B guidance.

**My estimate centers on $91.0B-$91.5B, with modest tail risks toward both $90B and $93B+.**

NVIDIA officially reported its Q1 FY2027 earnings on May 20, 2026, announcing a record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA provided strong forward guidance, projecting revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

Analysts' consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.8 billion, with estimates ranging from $90.3 billion to $96.7 billion [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates). NVIDIA expects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for Q2 FY2027 to be approximately 74.9% and 75.0%, respectively [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The company is expected to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings around August 26, 2026 [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates).
